Source structures grounded in two PO-provided files, synthesized safely (NO PII BYTES): .csv is UTF-16LE with BOM FF FE, TAB delimiters, Arabic sections (1. الملخص with title, start/end MM/DD/YY local string, 2. المشاركون with 7 columns الاسم/وقت الانضمام الأول/وقت المغادرة الأخير/مدة الاجتماع/البريد الإلكتروني/معرّف المشارك (UPN)/الدور, 3. الأنشطة داخل الاجتماع with join/leave segments). PO files show 20 participants incl 1 organizer and 23 incl 1 organizer, extra segment rows on 2 and 1 participant respectively, one only 10 seconds long. Do NOT copy their names, UPNs, emails into public docs or synthetic test.
